title: Remote ERPNext & Frappe Developer (3 Yrs Exp) | Custom Apps, v12–v16, ZATCA, Peppol, POS & APIs
text: Hello everyone, Looking for a reliable Remote ERPNext & Frappe Developer to clear your project backlog, build custom apps from scratch, or handle complex third-party integrations? I am a Full-Stack ERPNext & Frappe Consultant with 3 years of hands-on production experience . I partner with businesses, startups, and ERP agencies worldwide on an hourly, fixed-project, or dedicated monthly retainer basis. Core Expertise & Services Custom Frappe App & Module Development (ERPNext v12 – v16): Clean, upgrade-safe customizations using custom DocTypes, hooks, Server & Client Scripts, background workers, automated workflows, permission controllers, Jinja/QWeb print formats, and custom Script Reports. Functional & Technical Mastery Across Core Modules: End-to-end implementation and customization in Accounting, Point of Sale (POS Awesome), Sales, Purchase, Inventory/Stock, HR & Payroll, Manufacturing, and Lending . Government e-Invoicing & Tax Compliance Integrations: Proven production deployments for UAE Peppol e-Invoicing (InvoiceQ) , Saudi Arabia ZATCA (Fatoora Phase 1 & 2) , and Pakistan FBR Digital Invoicing . REST APIs, Webhooks & WhatsApp Automation: Two-way REST API integrations with e-commerce platforms, payment gateways, external ERPs, and automated WhatsApp alerts/document delivery. Database Optimization & Server Management:MariaDB & PostgreSQL query tuning, custom SQL indexing for high-volume sites, legacy data migrations, and Frappe Bench / Ubuntu Linux server deployment, backups, and version upgrades (v12–v16). Hybrid ERP & Frontend Capabilities: Hands-on experience with Vue.js for custom POS/portal interfaces, plus Odoo (v14–v19) for teams running multi-ERP setups or migrating from Odoo to ERPNext. Proven Production Track Record Successfully delivered custom ERPNext and POS solutions across Retail, Multi-Branch Distribution, Manufacturing, Healthcare/Hospital Management, Pharmaceuticals, and Petroleum industries—handling high-transaction POS environments and complex multi-warehouse operations. Why Work With Me? Clean, Maintainable Code: Strict adherence to Frappe best practices so your future version upgrades never break. Direct & Transparent Communication: Overlap with UK, EU, and GCC (UAE/KSA) time zones , daily progress updates, and Git-based workflows. Fast Turnaround: Ready to jump into existing codebases, debug urgent production issues, or architect new modules immediately.
